d: Lush turf with a deep green top and soft soil beneath.
Dark, fertile soil threaded with tiny roots and pebbles.
Blue-grey slate slabs with a chiselled border. Perfect for plazas.
Warm sandstone bricks with soft mortar lines.
Cream plaster with hand-troweled texture.
Dark oiled timber with vertical grain and wooden pegs.
Scalloped clay roof tiles in warm orange.
Overlapping fish-scale roof tiles in deep indigo.
Pink cherry-wood planks with a silky grain.
Bundled green bamboo stalks with growth nodes.
A faceted teal crystal that glows softly at night.
A warm glowing paper panel in a dark wooden frame.
Dark hexagonal basalt columns.
A mosaic of smooth river pebbles.
Pale icy bricks that sparkle.
Old cobblestones softened by moss.
Ornate gold inlay on dark stone.
Porous coral in sunset pink.
A swirling nebula sealed in stone. Stars drift and twinkle inside.
Ribbons of green and violet light ripple through frosted glass.
Pale marble veined with slowly shimmering gold stardust.
A cosy animated campfire. Stand close to warm up and slowly heal.
A small house door (1 wide, 2 tall). It swings open when you walk up to it and closes behind you.
